CHICKEN SAUSAGE MUFFIN 🍳

Macros per sandwich: 316 kcal | 30g protein (varies with add ons)

Ingredients (4 sandwiches)

Sausage patties
• 450g chicken mince
• 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika
• 1 tsp black pepper
• ¾ tsp salt
• ½ tsp chilli flakes
• 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
• ½ tbsp maple syrup (optional)

Per sandwich
• 1 English muffin
• 2 sausage patties
• ½ slice cheese
• Ketchup + yellow mustard (non negotiable!)

Method

1. Mix mince with all seasonings and Worcestershire sauce.
2. Shape into 8 thin patties.
3. Cook in a non stick pan for 3–4 mins per side, until fully cooked. No oil needed if the mince has enough fat.
4. Toast muffin, melt cheese over patties and assemble with ketchup and mustard. Add an egg if you like!

Pro tips 🌟

1. Maple syrup adds that sweet savoury sausage flavour. An egg boosts protein and satiety. Skip the butter!
2. No English muffins? Use a burger bun, soft bread or whole wheat bun. Toast for a golden outside.
3. Meal prep: Assemble with bread, patties and cheese, without sauces or veggies. Wrap and freeze, then reheat thoroughly and add sauces fresh.
4. You can freeze cooked patties separately too for quick sandwiches anytime!

P.S. 👀 We experimented with larger, thicker patties, so yours may look bigger than the ones in the video. Flatten them more for a classic McMuffin style.
